'''Sarissa Ven''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Wielding two [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in combat, she was one of the commanders of the Republic forces during the [[Battle of Ilum]].

==Behind the scenes==
Master Sarissa Ven was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'', which added Conquest Commanders to most of the dual-faction worlds. Ven is a rare NPC enemy, and her place at the [[Republic base camp]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] is frequently occupied by a generic Veteran Jedi Battlemaster.
